falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on volatility compression and orderly decline; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic selling and forced liquidation, breaking the structural similarity and invalidating the 'bottom' analog

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern matched a growth-scare bottom where yields stabilized or rose modestly; a plunge to sub-3.50% signals recession/depression pricing, not a tactical bottom, proving the macro regime is fundamentally different

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes 10% below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured controlled drawdowns with price holding near the 20DMA; a 10% gap violates the volatility regime and trend structure, confirming this is not the same pattern and the bottom call is wrong

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
